# tarragonleisure.com

> Tarragon Leisure is a Sri Lanka-based travel company designing bespoke, tailor-made tours, luxury safaris, and honeymoon itineraries for international travellers.

## About the Business

Tarragon Leisure is a boutique Sri Lanka travel operator based in Matara, Sri Lanka. The team designs personalised itineraries for couples, families, and solo travellers from the UK and international markets. Specialities include luxury wildlife safaris (Yala National Park), Cultural Triangle tours, honeymoon packages, and Sri Lanka-Maldives combination holidays.
